description: This file defines the ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser class that implements the MimeTypeGuesserInterface to guess MIME types based on file extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser
classes.description: A MIME type guesser that determines MIME type based on file extension, supporting CSS and JavaScript files.

methods.name: isGuesserSupported
methods.description: Indicates if this MIME type guesser is supported, returning true.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type based on the file extension of the given path; returns specific MIME types for 'css' and 'js' extensions, otherwise null.
